# Feature: audio:generate + audio:process

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-07-24 — issue #85 -->

**featureSlug:** `audio-generate-process`  
**Issue:** #85  
**Depends on:** #83 (merged)

## Intent

Ship `stable_audio_local` provider adapter (fail loud if missing — no silent cloud) and an FFmpeg `audio:process` pipeline that produces masters + web formats. Keep mock provider CI-safe with no API keys.

## Preconditions

- Repo at `Letz-Fetz-Game/`; Python 3.11+ available for forge tests.
- Audio Forge scaffold + mock from #83 present under `tools/audio-forge/`.
- FFmpeg available on PATH for process happy path (tests may skip encode when absent and assert clear error path).

## Happy Path

- [ ] `npm run audio:generate -- --provider mock --id card.draw` writes a deterministic candidate WAV under forge output.
- [ ] `--provider stable_audio_local` without local install exits non-zero with an explicit install error (no HTTP/cloud call).
- [ ] `npm run audio:process -- --id <…>` (or input path) uses FFmpeg to write master WAV + web formats (mp3/ogg) under forge output dirs.
- [ ] Python tests for mock generate + process (and missing-install / missing-ffmpeg errors) are green.
- [ ] No secrets or API keys required for default (mock) path.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] FFmpeg missing → clear stderr error + non-zero exit.
- [ ] Unknown provider name → clear error (no silent fallback to cloud).
- [ ] Partial batch: per-ID failure reported; other IDs may still succeed.
- [ ] Unknown sound id → exit 2.

## Regression

- [ ] `audio:audit` / `audio:plan` / `audio:help` still work.
- [ ] Frontend bundle unchanged regarding forge (tools-only).
- [ ] `npm run checks` green.

## Assumptions

- Local Stable Audio is optional; adapter detects install via env override or importable local package marker — never Stability cloud APIs.
- Masters = loudnorm WAV; web = mp3 + ogg under `tools/audio-forge/output/{masters,web}/`.
- Auto-approval into runtime registry is out of scope (#86).
